# Curves

Tone curves like a photo editor’s: a master curve for contrast and one curve per channel for color, through smooth points that never overshoot.

<EffectDemo effect="curves" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { curves } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/curves';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(curves({ preset: 'contrast' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.master = [[0, 0], [1, 1]]`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Default            | Range | Description                                                |
| --------- | -------- | ------------------ | ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `master`  | [x, y][] | `[[0, 0], [1, 1]]` |       | Maps input brightness (x) to output (y) for every channel. |
| `red`     | [x, y][] | `[[0, 0], [1, 1]]` |       | The red channel’s curve.                                   |
| `green`   | [x, y][] | `[[0, 0], [1, 1]]` |       | The green channel’s curve.                                 |
| `blue`    | [x, y][] | `[[0, 0], [1, 1]]` |       | The blue channel’s curve.                                  |
| `amount`  | number   | `1`                | 0 – 1 | Mix between the original and the curved image.             |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset         | Settings                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contrast`     | `master: [[0, 0], [0.25, 0.18], [0.75, 0.84], [1, 1]]`                                                                                   |
| `fade`         | `master: [[0, 0.1], [0.5, 0.52], [1, 0.92]]`                                                                                             |
| `crossProcess` | `red: [[0, 0], [0.3, 0.22], [0.7, 0.8], [1, 1]]`, `green: [[0, 0.03], [0.5, 0.55], [1, 1]]`, `blue: [[0, 0.12], [0.5, 0.45], [1, 0.85]]` |
| `moody`        | `master: [[0, 0.05], [0.3, 0.22], [0.7, 0.72], [1, 0.95]]`, `blue: [[0, 0.08], [0.5, 0.5], [1, 0.95]]`                                   |

Apply one with `curves({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.10 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/curves`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Per-channel tone curves through monotone cubic control points (Fritsch and Carlson, 1980), baked to textures.
